Subject: Discrepancy on Feb invoice - INV-20260228

Hi Grace,

We're reviewing our February billing and noticed a discrepancy on invoice INV-20260228 (attached). Line 4 — billed as "Burst capacity (on-demand)" — shows 3,200 GPU-minutes. Our internal usage reports only 1,900 GPU-minutes for Feb. That difference is material to our month-end close.

Two quick asks: can you confirm how you derived that line item and provide an adjustment or credit if this is an overcharge? Also, please confirm how you will represent VAT on any credit note (we need to reconcile VAT on our books).

I've attached the invoice and our PO (PO-5371) for reference. If helpful, I can loop in our AP contact.

Thanks,
Marta Alvarez
Finance Director
Nova Places

Hi Marta, Grace — Marcus from Finance here. I pulled the billing ledger and the serving runtime logs for Feb and ran a reconciliation between our billed GPU-minutes and the usage that generated chargeable tokens. Summary below: 

Summary of findings
- Invoice INV-20260228, Burst capacity line: billed 3,200 GPU-minutes (gross)
- Logged usage tied to Nova Places API key: 1,898 GPU-minutes
- Delta: 1,302 GPU-minutes (approximately $1,706.40 at your agreed rate)

Root cause (likely): an automated annotation job for a short-lived dev cluster in eu-west-1 retained a customer tag for 48 hours beyond the scheduled shutdown. That job's metrics were captured in the billing run due to a label mismatch in our ingestion pipeline. We're treating this as an overbilling.

Proposed remedial actions
- Issue a goodwill credit equal to the gross charged amount for the 1,302 GPU-minutes (including VAT applied on the original invoice). Exact gross value: EUR 1,972.90 (VAT inclusive at 20%).
- We will produce a formal credit note that references INV-20260228 and clearly shows VAT reversal entries so your AP can reconcile.
- Option for settlement: apply the credit to your next invoice (auto-apply) or process a direct bank refund. If you choose refund, we'll need bank details or a signed refund instruction on company letterhead.

Next steps for Nova Places (what we need from you)
- Confirm VAT registration and provide VAT ID to appear on the credit note.
- Confirm preference: credit applied to next invoice OR direct refund (plus payment details if refund).

I've attached a short spreadsheet with my line-item math for transparency. Once we have your confirmation, Grace and I will finalize the credit note and get it in your hands.

Attachment: proposed-credit-calculation.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 14KB)

Regards,
Marcus Lin

- Credit note: CN-20260319-NOVA (attached: CreditNote-NovaPlaces-03192026.pdf)
- Credit amount (gross): EUR 1,972.90 (VAT 20% reversed on credit note)
- Refund method: Bank transfer to the account in AP-payment-instructions.pdf
- Refund ETA: payment will be processed by our bank within 7 business days from today (expect cleared funds by 2026-03-29).
- HubSpot ticket: NP-7892 (we've recorded the credit and payment there)

If you'd rather have the credit applied instead of a refund, tell us before the payment clears and we can stop the payout and apply it to your next invoice.

Apologies again for the inconvenience — we've also raised an internal ops task to add an extra validation on tag expiration to avoid similar mis-labeling. Evelyn will follow up on the ops item and keep you updated.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
